name: pi-legion
description: Pi Legion v2: recursive centurion teams on Pi. Children run in-process by default (rpc only for a worktree-owning centurion); shared SQLite WAL legion.db. Declarative per-team phase machine (built-in default: planning/implementing/reviewing/verifying), pa
